addSheetFilenameHint: Leave blank to use the server's filename
addSheetSubtitle: Enter a URL. SDM will start a multi-threaded download immediately.
cliInstallConflict: another sdm is already in PATH, left it alone:
cliInstallNoPath: installed, but the folder is not in PATH:
clipboardSheetSubtitle: This URL looks like a downloadable file. Confirm or skip.
detailRestartedHint: The file on the server has changed, so it could not be resumed — the download was restarted from the beginning.
emptyHint: Click + or press ⌘N to add a URL. Drop a download in Firefox/Safari to send it to SDM. From a terminal: `sdm add <url>`. Drag a URL onto this window.
emptyTipLang: Settings → Language to switch to 中文.
expiredRelinkRestart: New link cannot resume, restarting download
historyExplanation: Completed and failed downloads show up here. Right-click for actions.
scheduleHint: Pick a URL and a future time above.
settingsCategoriesHint: Add / remove extensions in v1.0.5+. The v1.0 list lives in the code; an in-app editor arrives later.
settingsCategoriesPlaceholder: Categories are auto-detected from file extension. Toggle in Active tab toolbar.
settingsCategoryFolderHint: Downloads land in ~/Downloads/<Category>/ when classification is on.
settingsHideDockHint: Keep a menu-bar icon only. The dock icon reappears while a window is open.
settingsIgnoreSSLHint: Disables TLS chain validation for every connection. Use this if a host is reverse-proxied through an edge whose certificate isn't in the system keychain. Off by default — only turn on for sources you trust.
settingsLogsLevelHint: Lower levels include everything above. Debug is the most verbose; Error only fatal faults.
settingsLogsPreviewEmpty: No log entries yet. Start a download to populate the log.
settingsOpenAtLoginHint: Registers the app with macOS as a login item.
settingsShowToolbarLabelsHint: Show an icon AND a text label on each toolbar button. Off = icons only.
settingsToggleHideDockWhenWindowClosed: Hide dock icon when window is closed
siteRulesExplanation: Match downloads by hostname (suffix match). Applied rules add Referer / User-Agent / Cookie / Basic Auth headers.
addSheetProxyHint: Leave blank to use the global proxy
addSheetHeadersHint: Optional. Sites with Referer / Cookie usually need them.
addSheetProbeUnavailable: This build cannot probe URLs — fill in the filename yourself
addSheetErrorNoTime: A scheduled download needs a fire time.
expiredMoreWaiting: \(0) more tasks awaiting a new link
settingsThemeHint: Follow system / light / dark. The toolbar has a shortcut too.
settingsMaxConcurrentHint: Extra downloads wait in the queue until a slot frees up.
settingsChunkLimitsHint: Connections at the start of a download, and the most chunks one task may use.
settingsGlobalProxyHint: Every download goes through this proxy. Blank = no proxy.
settingsUserAgentHint: Sent with every download. Blank = the built-in default. A site rule's UA still wins.
browserCaptureExplanation: With the browser extension installed, downloads started in your browser can be handed over to this app: chunking, speed limits, categories and automatic file naming all happen here. The extension lives in the folder below — install it once per browser using the steps for that browser.
browserCaptureUnavailable: Could not read the browser capture status. Try restarting the app.
browserCaptureTokenHint: Safari needs this token pasted in by hand. Chrome and Firefox pair automatically once the extension is installed.
browserCaptureCopyFailed: Copy failed — the token is selected, please copy it manually.
browserCaptureResetDone: A new token was generated. The old one no longer works.
browserCaptureFolderMissing: Extension folder not found — the extension may not be bundled with the app.
browserCaptureHostReady: Native messaging host is ready — the extension works as soon as it is installed.
browserCaptureHostMissing: Native messaging host is not installed. Restart the app after installing the extension.
browserCaptureSafariSteps: Safari install steps: Settings → Advanced → turn on “Show features for web developers”; Settings → Developer → tick “Allow unsigned extensions”; Settings → Developer → “Add Temporary Extension…” → pick the Safari extension folder above; finally tick “Super Download Manager” in Settings → Extensions.
browserCaptureTemporaryNote: Safari's temporary extensions come with platform limits: they are removed when Safari quits, the “allow unsigned extensions” setting resets too, and a temporary extension expires after 24 hours. The Safari extension can only hand off downloads manually — it cannot capture them automatically.
browserCaptureReloadHint: After the extension files change, hit “Reload” once on the browser's extensions page for the change to take effect.
settingsToggleClipboardCaptureHint: Copy a download link and you get a confirmation prompt. Only links whose extension maps to a known file type (zip / dmg / mp4 …) are picked up — ordinary links from chat are ignored.
